questions.Description: Conduct an experiment to study various sampling methods used in mineral processing and demonstrate the procedure of obtaining a representative sample.
Study the petrological microscope, identify its parts, and understand its working principle and used in mineral identification.
Identify and study two metallic minerals using a petrological microscope and record their optical properties.
Study the operation of a jaw crusher / gyratory crusher and determine the reduction ratio.
Perform secondary crushing using a cone crusher and determine the size reduction ratio
Perform size reduction using a ball mill / hammer mill and determine the particle size distribution.
Verify Stokes’ Law for particle settling through a fluid by using sedimentation decantation method.
Separate ore particles by jigging and study the effect of pulsation on concentration efficiency.
Perform gravity separation using a Wilfley table and study the separation of minerals based on specific gravity.
Study the working of a spiral concentrator and perform separation of minerals by specific gravity difference.
